Do NOT read or send verbatim psych narratives or any specially protected items—limit to actionable safety instructions and brief, non‑narrative risk statements.  
Document in the chart who made the decision, the clinical facts supporting imminent risk, the exact content disclosed, recipient identity, time, that the emergency exception was used, and the planned re‑evaluation; notify the privacy officer promptly after disclosure.
